name: Relative Positioning
description: 1. List all objects. 2. Apply each positional constraint to place objects. 3. Ensure no two objects occupy the same position. 4. Verify the final order.
applies_when: When statements provide relative positions of objects.
does_not_apply_when: When statements involve 'between', 'next to', or 'second from the left'.

name: Interpret 'left of' and 'right of'
description: 1. Identify the reference object. 2. Determine the direction ('left of' or 'right of'). 3. Place the object accordingly.
does_not_apply_when: Statements use 'between', 'next to', or 'second from the left'.

name: Analyze Relative Positions
description: Identify the relative positions of objects based on given constraints.
applies_when: When objects are arranged in a fixed order and constraints provide relative positions.
does_not_apply_when: When objects are not arranged in a fixed order or constraints do not involve relative positions.

name: Resolve conflicting constraints
description: 1. List all constraints. 2. Identify any conflicting constraints. 3. Re-evaluate the constraints to find a consistent order. 4. Place the objects in the correct order.
applies_when: Multiple constraints create a conflict that cannot be resolved without re-evaluating the clues.
does_not_apply_when: Single constraints or straightforward ordering problems; arithmetic word problems; date and calendar questions.

name: Correctly interpret 'between' or 'next to'
description: 1. Identify the reference points. 2. Place the object between or next to them. 3. Verify the order respects all given relationships.
does_not_apply_when: Statements using 'second from the left' or 'right of'; ordering by value.

name: Check Consistency
description: Verify that the deduced order is consistent with all given constraints.
applies_when: After deducing the order from constraints.
does_not_apply_when: Before starting to deduce the order.

name: Verify 'Second from Left/Right'
description: 1. Identify the reference point. 2. Count positions from the reference point. 3. Ensure the object is placed correctly.
applies_when: When determining positions using 'second from the left/right'.
does_not_apply_when: When ordering by value; solving arithmetic problems.

name: Analyze Positional Constraints
description: Identify and prioritize positional constraints to arrange objects correctly.
applies_when: When objects are arranged in a fixed order with positional constraints.
does_not_apply_when: When objects are not arranged in a fixed order or without positional constraints.

name: Order of Events and Constraints
description: 1. List all constraints. 2. Apply each constraint in sequence. 3. Ensure no contradictions arise. 4. Verify the final order.
applies_when: When statements provide multiple constraints that need to be applied sequentially.

name: Determine Second-to-Last/Third-to-Last Item
description: Identify the second-to-last or third-to-last item based on given constraints.
applies_when: When the question involves determining the position of the second-to-last or third-to-last item.
does_not_apply_when: When the question does not involve these specific positions.

name: Avoid placing objects in occupied positions
description: 1. List all objects and their current positions. 2. Check if the new placement conflicts with existing positions. 3. If conflict, re-evaluate the placement.
applies_when: Placing objects based on relative positions.
does_not_apply_when: Clues involving 'between', 'next to', ordering by value, solving arithmetic problems.

name: Analyze Positional Constraints
description: Identify and prioritize constraints to determine the exact position of items.
applies_when: When dealing with multiple positional constraints in a sequence.
does_not_apply_when: When the constraints do not involve positions.

name: Position Relative Analysis
description: Analyze the relative positions of objects to deduce their exact placement.
applies_when: When given pairwise or positional constraints about objects.
does_not_apply_when: When the constraints do not involve relative positions.

name: Position Relative Check
description: Check the relative positions of objects and ensure the second-to-last and third-to-last objects are correctly identified.
applies_when: When arranging objects in a fixed order and dealing with second-to-last or third-to-last positions.
does_not_apply_when: When the objects are not arranged in a fixed order or the question does not involve second-to-last or third-to-last positions.

name: Position Constraint Resolution
description: Identify and resolve conflicting position constraints.
applies_when: When multiple constraints provide conflicting positions for an element.
does_not_apply_when: When constraints do not involve conflicting positions.

name: Rightmost Object Identification
description: Identify the rightmost object by checking the given constraints and logical deductions.
applies_when: When determining the rightmost object in a fixed order arrangement.
does_not_apply_when: When objects are not arranged in a fixed order or constraints do not specify the rightmost object.

name: Price Comparison
description: Arrange items based on given price relationships (e.g., most expensive, least expensive, more/less expensive).
applies_when: When items are described by their price relationships (e.g., more expensive, less expensive, most expensive).
does_not_apply_when: When items are described by their relative positions without price information.

name: Understand 'second from the left/right'
description: 1. List all objects. 2. Identify the first or last object. 3. Determine the second object from the identified position.
applies_when: Statements mention 'second from the left' or 'second from the right'.

name: Verify relative positioning
description: 1. Write down the relative positions of objects as given. 2. Check if the positions are consistent with each other. 3. Adjust the positions if inconsistencies are found. 4. Ensure the final order matches all given constraints.
does_not_apply_when: Absolute positioning problems; arithmetic word problems; Boolean expressions.
